summary: Per-frame AI steering target computation. Scans the 5-lane lateral-boundary table, computes a centre steering value clamped between left/right bounds, evaluates the nearest opponent in each lane via spatial nearest-neighbour queries, scores lanes and picks steering targets, and drives overtaking state transitions (mode codes 1/2/4/7/8/16) with session-time steering overrides.

operations.description: Guard: skip a lane candidate when its in-garage flag (track-position data +0x12C) equals 1.
Guard: callToBox flag (this+0x454C) equals 1 enables pit-box steering override path.
Guard: pit-lane entry flag (this+0x4550) equals 1 enables pit-lane steering override path.

Scan the 5 lane entries (lane table at this+0x4174, pointers also read through this+0x4354 / this+0x4358) and track the running left-boundary minimum (+0x50) and right-boundary maximum (+0x54) across lane track-position data.
Compute centre steering (this+0x4420), the boundary midpoint, and normalised left/right lateral ratios from the current lateral offset (this+0x441C), bounded by this+0x4414 and this+0x4418.
If the steering-latch byte (this+0x4579) is set, snap or step the steering target (this+0x440C) toward centre (this+0x4420) in 0.2 increments.

Reset per-frame state: clear steering-latch byte (0x4579), overtake side indices (0x4570 / 0x4574), overtake counter (0x455C), reset override gain to 1.0 (0x4554) and clear the block flag byte (0x456C).

Session-time gates (global session time vs race-time offset): when dbl_8AFEA0 < flt_8ACF90 + 6.5 / + 2.5, override the steering target (this+0x440C) from the selected opponent car (indexed via this+0x4468 and this+0x44FC) and this+0x4428.
Primary spatial query: SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch(dword_5EA2C0, lane car +0x34E0, ..., this+0x4550, 0) to find the nearest opponent car for the current lane.
Store the nearest-neighbour result index into the lane entry slot (this+0x41AC).
If the candidate car is not on track (lane-car status 0x32C8) while the own car is, or the candidate car is the own car, fall back to BVHNearestNeighborQuery; otherwise skip scoring.
ShortComputation_3ca0 computes the lateral offset between this car and the opponent using RenderZ/forward/lateral components (this+0x34F8 / 0x34FC / 0x3500) and speed (this+0x4440).
ShortComputation_3db0 computes forward distance and angle to the opponent using lane offsets (this+0x34E0 / 0x34E4 / 0x34E8) and stored lane-track values (this+0x448C / 0x4490 / 0x4494).
VehicleDynamics is run for the opponent (from the lane slot this+0x41AC) and for the current car (indexed via this+0x4468) to derive closing dynamics.

Compute closing-rate/time-to-gap (from lane front distance this+0x4180 and gap this+0x41A4), look up the matching slot in the 20-entry table at this+17096 via lane slot index (this+0x41B4), defaulting the stored index to -1 when no slot matches.
If the lane car lacks a valid track flag (status 0x32C8 clear) or the car is nearly stationary, force the score sentinel (-10000) and reset the cached target slot.
Insert the lane score into the sorted 5-best list, shifting the per-lane index assignments (scores and lane front distances from this+0x4180).

Evaluate each of the 5 best candidates: skip out-of-range lane distance (this+0x41A8), test yaw alignment (own track-data +0xB8 vs candidate), lateral offset (this+0x4450 with flt_5EA3FC width), speed-scaled penalty using this+0x4440 / this+0x4438 / this+0x44A4, and overtake aggression factors this+0x4414 / this+0x4418 / this+0x44F8.
Compare the own car's session/team identity (dereferenced via this+0x0) against the opponent car's identity and apply a -95 steering bias when the opponent is ahead.
TrackParameterMinimumClamp enforces speed-target floors derived from speed (this+0x4440) and candidate lateral state.
SignedIndexTableLookup selects the steering/lane index from the computed target (this+0x4428) and lane aggression (this+0x44F8).
Update the per-lane overtake timer slot (this+17116 region) using lane lateral speed (this+0x41A4 context) and speed thresholds (this+0x4438 / this+0x4480), clamped to the timer ceiling.

When a candidate triggers overtaking, increment the overtake counter (this+0x455C and this+0x4508), set the steering-latch byte (this+0x4579), and record the side index (this+0x4570 / this+0x4574) from the candidate car's stored counter values; reads overtaking-allowance fields (obj +0x48A4 / +0x48A8) and the callToBox guard (this+0x4544).

Steering-state reset when the lane entry is empty or speed (this+0x4440) exceeds the threshold (this+0x4480): re-seed the target slot (this+0x4488 byte and timer) before recomputing the candidate path.
For overtaking modes (v86 == 1/2/7/8), call Overtaking(this, v86), increment this+0x4508, and refine the lateral target using this+0x4428 / this+0x4414 / this+0x4418.

Commit the final steering output: write this+0x4408 from this+0x440C, apply overrides from this+0x4420 and this+0x4424, honour the pit-steering byte (this+0x4548), set the boundary flag byte (this+0x4140) when the target exceeds the lateral bounds (this+0x4414 / this+0x4418 / this+0x4440), and clear the flag byte (this+0x4488).

clean_pseudocode: steeringTarget = clamp(centre, leftBound, rightBound); snap ±0.2 if latch set
if sessionTime < raceTimeOffset + 6.5 or + 2.5: steeringTarget = opponent-derived value
for each lane: nearest = SpatialTreeQuery(...); if on-track mismatch: nearest = BVHQuery(...)
compute closing dynamics via ShortComputation_3ca0/3db0 + VehicleDynamics
insert lane score into sorted 5-best; score each candidate for overtaking
for best candidates: mode = f(lateral, yaw, speed, overtake counters); commit this+0x4408
if target outside [leftBound, rightBound]: set boundary flag byte 0x4140
